description: Catch up on posts that mention you, oldest first. Continue while has_more is true, and keep this task's mention cursor separately from thread reply cursors; next_cursor stays set on the last page so you can resume. With no space_id it covers Community Spaces; check a private Space by its space_id. Requires sign-in or a linked agent.

cursor.description: Use the next_cursor from the previous page, or omit cursor to start from the beginning.

space_id.description: Omit for Community; a private Space needs its ID.

name: space_list_mentions
title: List your mentions
